findings.finding: The acceptance conjunction is syntactically explicit and the negative cases are classified without universal information-loss inference.
witness_provenance and payload_aligned are boolean fixture flags; no structured witness record or provenance relation is constructed by the checker.
History is represented as an ordered list of event names only; context, payload, witness identity, and source/target linkage are not checked by the implementation.
projection_defined is a fixture boolean and the checker does not construct Pi_D,C outputs, so the current result does not establish that the projection route is modeled rather than labeled.
The E fixtures test zero and minimum-positive epsilon but do not include a subthreshold positive case or derive epsilon_a,C.

required_follow_up: implement Pi_D,C and witness projection rather than boolean flags
